description: This file defines the ListToList class, a method operation used within the OFBiz MiniLang framework to convert and transfer list elements from one list to another during method execution. It implements logic for pairing specific environment map attributes representing lists and appending data accordingly.

classes.name: ListToList
classes.description: MethodOperation subclass implementing a list-to-list transfer operation within the MiniLang framework, facilitating copying elements between environment map attributes.

classes.name: ListToListFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating ListToList instances corresponding to the <list-to-list> element.

methods.name: ListToList
methods.description: Constructor initializing the operation, validating attributes, and setting up accessors for source and destination list attributes.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the list transfer by fetching source list, creating destination list if needed, and adding all source elements to the destination list.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the ListToList instance, including the configured environment map attributes.
